tasks.query: Interrupting an interactive prompt with Ctrl-C should abort cleanly without a secondary unhandled exception caused by terminal output cleanup.
Command help containing non-ASCII characters should render on Windows terminals without failing with an encoding error.
Opening a URL from a command-line application on Windows should invoke the operating-system launcher without a file-not-found error.
Writing ordinary text through the pager on Windows should receive a text-capable stream instead of failing because the temporary pager stream expects bytes.
A request using the wrong HTTP method for a route inside a middleware-enabled group should produce method-not-allowed rather than being mistaken for a missing route.
A route group with middleware should still fall back to the application's root missing-route handler when no more specific handler exists.
Binding request parameters into a map whose values are not assignable from strings should not panic; incompatible values should be handled safely.
HTTP response trailers should be transmitted correctly when the server uses cleartext HTTP/2, matching the behavior seen with HTTP/1.1.
A panic in one worker while walking files in parallel should propagate or terminate promptly instead of leaving the traversal nondeterministically hung.
Checking whether every pattern matches a path must test each individual pattern, even when several patterns are optimized into the same matching strategy.
Ignore rules should be applied consistently when several explicit search roots are supplied, regardless of the order of those roots.
Generated file hyperlinks for paths containing spaces and non-ASCII characters should percent-encode each path component exactly once.
Clearing mocking caches should not strip method parameter names or other reflection metadata from classes that were previously mocked.
The first attempt to mock a record with an annotation on one constructor component should succeed consistently instead of failing only for certain parameter arrangements.
A mock configured to return itself for fluent calls should not return the mock for a method whose generic return type resolves to an incompatible terminal type.
Tests running as named Java modules should not fail during agent startup because internal mocking classes are inaccessible to the instrumentation module.
On Windows, a development server bound to localhost should remain reachable through another local development server's proxy even when IPv4 and IPv6 resolution order differs.

During server-side module transformation, an imported value used as a computed key inside a destructured function parameter with a default value should be rewritten correctly instead of becoming an undefined bare reference.
Test setup modules should resolve correctly on Windows when the project is entered through a directory link that crosses drive letters, rather than collapsing the setup path to a drive root.
CSS minification must preserve an explicit cascade-layer ordering declaration because removing it can change stylesheet precedence.
Rendering child content inside a standard HTML template element should place nodes in the element's template content rather than attaching them as ordinary children.
Authorization middleware nested inside a path-mapped application branch should not trigger a warning that it is outside the routing and endpoint region when its local ordering is correct.
Cache keys must distinguish multiple values of the same vary header from one concatenated header value so semantically different requests cannot collide.

A WebAssembly development server in a development environment should automatically use an available trusted HTTPS development certificate after package upgrades, without requiring an explicit certificate path.
